## Course overview

Econometrics I introduces the logic and practice of empirical economic analysis. The course emphasizes identification, estimation, diagnostics, interpretation, and reproducible work.

## Learning objectives

By the end of the course, students should be able to formulate an empirical question, select an appropriate model, assess its assumptions, interpret estimates, and communicate uncertainty.

## Modules

1. Data, questions, and empirical design
2. Probability and statistical foundations
3. Simple and multiple regression
4. Statistical inference
5. Functional form and model specification
6. Heteroskedasticity and robust inference
7. Endogeneity and identification
8. Reproducible empirical projects
